qa.question: How do I process a customer refund?
qa.text: Open Orders, find the order and only refund it if status is Delivered and Check stock shows the item is back in stock [S1]. Choose a refund reason, click Issue refund, type the order number again in the confirmation dialog and click Confirm refund [S1]. Refunds cannot be reversed once confirmed [S1]. For supervisor approval, Customer refund process (simulated back office) says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code, while How to process a customer refund (screen recording, simulated back office) says any refund above $500 needs a supervisor code [S1] [S3].

qa.question: Why do we check stock before paying a refund?
qa.text: We check stock because the returned item must be back in stock before any refund is paid [S1]. The item has to be back on the shelf before we pay anything out [S2].

qa.question: Above what amount does a refund need a supervisor code?
qa.text: The Customer refund process says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code [S1]. The How to process a customer refund video says any refund above $500 needs a supervisor code [S2].

qa.question: What was Viet Nam's GDP growth in 2023?
qa.text: The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report reports Viet Nam's 2023 real GDP growth was 5.0 percent [S1]. That report says the Philippines grew fastest in 2023 at 5.5 percent [S2]. The Regional expansion review deck says Viet Nam grew 6.5% in 2023, the fastest economy in ASEAN [S4].

qa.question: Which country grew fastest in 2024?
qa.text: Viet Nam grew fastest in 2024 with real GDP growth of 7.0 percent [S1]. It was ahead of Cambodia at 6.0 percent and the Philippines at 5.7 percent [S1].

qa.question: How did Myanmar's economy do in 2024?
qa.text: Myanmar's real GDP contracted by 1.0 percent in 2024 [S1]. This followed growth of 1.0 percent in 2023 and 4.0 percent in 2022 [S2]. Its GDP was 74.1 billion current US dollars in 2024, with manufacturing at 25.1 percent of GDP [S4].

qa.question: What is the exact 2023 GDP growth value for Viet Nam in the licensed dataset?
qa.text: The ASEAN indicators dataset lists Viet Nam's 2023 GDP growth as 4.9787 [S1] [S7].

qa.question: What was Indonesia's GDP in current US dollars in 2024?
qa.text: Indonesia's GDP in current US dollars in 2024 was 1396301788462 [S7]. The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report 2019 to 2024 reports this as 1396.3 billions [S2].

qa.question: How much can I spend per month without asking?
qa.text: You are assigned a single User Limit of $5,000 per month in Brex for individual subscriptions, coworking/collaboration, equipment, training and similar spending [S3]. The $5,000 is a ceiling, not a target, and you should only spend what you can justify as being in PostHog's best interest [S3]. For books, spending up to $50/month is fine and requires no extra permission [S1].

qa.question: How many days off am I expected to take each year?
qa.text: You are expected to take at least 25 days off a year, including national holidays [S1]. PostHog offers unlimited time off, and the 25 days is a minimum, not a guide [S1].

qa.question: How long is the notice period if I resign?
qa.text: If you resign, PostHog asks for 30 days of notice by default and expects you to work during that period [S2]. A different limit may apply locally [S2].

qa.question: How much can I spend on books each month without asking?
qa.text: You can spend up to $50/month on books without asking for permission [S1].

qa.question: Who owns a side project that I built using company code?
qa.text: A side project born from work inside PostHog using PostHog code belongs to PostHog and should live in PostHog repos [S2]. If you want to develop it further on the side, you will need explicit permission [S2].

qa.question: How much time do company meetings take per week at most?
qa.text: Company meetings take no more than 2hrs total per week [S1].
